text: Hannah and Thomas got engaged on Saturday night in Lisbon. She was practically glowing when she told me. Wedding probably summer 2027, nothing booked yet.
Remind me to text Eli the evening before his anniversary dinner on the 14th. Ten years with Kerry, which is frankly amazing.
Nora lives in Didsbury now, just off the high street. Works as a pharmacist at the big Boots in town. Her sister Lola is still in Leeds.
Lunch with Anil. His daughter starts at the new nursery on Monday morning and he's more nervous about it than she is.

Rohan's wedding is on 2 November 2026 at 1pm, ceremony at the registry office then the reception at the Old Mill. I'm driving Ibrahim and his wife up, leaving ours at about 10 to allow for traffic on the M6. Rohan says his mum has been in charge of the seating plan and it has caused at least two family arguments already, so he's mainly looking forward to it being over.
Elif mentioned her parents' 40th anniversary is coming up in March 2027. She and her brother Kai are planning a surprise party. I should ask how I can help.
Pick up suit from the dry cleaner's tomorrow morning before 10.
Adaeze has two kids, both at St Mary's. Her husband Chidi works nights at the hospital, so she does all the school runs.

Sinead called. The engagement party on Friday at 7pm is off; she and Patrick split up last week. Apparently he'd been seeing someone from work for months. She's staying with her sister in Ennis for now and says she's okay, but she clearly isn't. Need to check in with her over the weekend, and maybe offer to help return the gifts people had already sent.
Mandla is allergic to shellfish, worth remembering for the dinner. He's veggie most of the time anyway.
Aisha's driving test is Thursday at 2pm. She failed the first one and is really anxious. Must text her good luck that morning.
Dmitri and his partner are moving to Bristol in January 2027. He's got a job lined up at the university there, lecturing in chemistry.
Don't forget to send Patrick a card the week after his mum's operation. It's on the 9th, so maybe the 16th or so.
Lorenzo's wife is expecting their second, due early April 2027. He seemed thrilled but exhausted.
Karan said his brother Sam is getting married in Goa next December. Whole family flying out for ten days.
Sadia works for the council in planning. Lives with her mum in Walthamstow. Her dad passed a few years ago.
Chatted to Tiago at the school gate. His dog Biscuit has to have a tooth out on Wednesday afternoon, poor thing. He's dreading the vet bill more than anything.
Remind me to call Ahmed the day before his interview at the bank. It's on the 27th at half 9.

Yaw and Femi are celebrating their fifth wedding anniversary on 18 November 2026. Yaw keeps dropping hints that Femi would love a weekend in the Lake District. Might suggest it to him again, since he clearly hasn't booked anything yet and keeps saying work is too busy to plan it. I could send him the link to that cottage near Keswick we stayed in, which had a hot tub and a decent pub ten minutes' walk away.
Chen's grandmother turns 90 on Sunday. Big lunch at the Chinese place on Oxford Road at 12:30. Chen asked if I'd take photos, which I've said I'll do.
Bilal has just started a new job at a fintech startup in Shoreditch. Says the hours are long but he loves it.
Need to book the boiler service for sometime next week, ideally Tuesday or Wednesday morning.
Anya is in Edinburgh doing her PhD in marine biology. Her partner Lola stayed down in Brighton for work.
Rang Kerry. Her dad is in hospital again with his chest, they're keeping him in until at least Friday. She sounded really worn out. I should pop round with some food tomorrow evening.
Hannah's hen do is the weekend of 12 June 2027 in Brighton. Nora is organising it. I owe Nora £80 for the deposit, need to transfer it by the end of the month.
Thomas, or Tommo as everyone at football calls him, has finally got his promotion to head of sales. Starts the new role on the 1st.
Eli's grandad Patrick lives in a care home in Cork. Eli flies over to see him every couple of months.
Remember to message Elif the week after the anniversary party to see how it all went. Party is Saturday 6 March 2027.
Mrs Murphy next door mentioned her son is getting engaged at Christmas. She's thrilled and already planning outfits.
Rohan and his fiancée Sadia are honeymooning in Japan straight after the wedding. Back around 20 November. Must send them the photos once they're home.
Anil grew up in Nairobi, moved here at sixteen. His wife Elif is a dentist and they live out in Chorlton with their cat Pickle.
Dentist appointment Friday at 3pm. Don't forget to bring the forms.

Adaeze told me she and Chidi are renewing their vows next summer for their 15th anniversary. Small thing, just family, somewhere by the sea. She said a nice photo frame would be perfect if I wanted to get them something.
Uncle Femi had his knee replacement on Monday. Mum says he's grumpy but recovering well. I should give him a ring on Thursday evening.
Karan is a sound engineer and spends most of the year touring. Lives in a flat above a bakery in Hackney. His girlfriend Anya is a nurse.
Dr Kim's surgery has moved to the new health centre on Park Lane.
Mandla's sister Aisha graduated last week with a first in law. The whole family went down to Durham for the ceremony. Send her congratulations.

Lorenzo told me he's been struggling since the redundancy in September. Interviews have dried up, his savings are running low, and he's not sleeping well. His wife Anya has gone back to full-time hours to cover the mortgage, which he feels guilty about. Remind me to check in with him next Monday, and maybe take him for a coffee the week after.
Sinead and Patrick's wedding was beautiful. She cried during the vows, he cried during the speeches.

Ibrahim's daughter Lola has her grade 5 piano exam on 3 December 2026 at 11am. He says she's practising every night but is terrified. Remind me to ask him how it went that evening. If she passes, she's hoping to start on grade 6 in the new year, and her teacher has already suggested she enter the regional competition in spring.

Tiago works from home for a design agency in Lisbon. His wife Sinead is Irish, from Galway originally, and they've got three boys, all under ten. They moved here mainly for her job at the university, where she runs the languages department. Tiago says he misses the weather in Portugal but not the commute, and they're thinking about buying rather than renting next year.
Nora said her parents are celebrating their ruby anniversary on 22 May 2027 with a big dinner. She's not sure whether to give a speech.
Kai got engaged to his girlfriend Elif over the weekend! Proposed on top of Snowdon at sunrise. Need to send a card and maybe a bottle of something.
Grocery run tonight. Out of milk, bread, coffee.

Dimitri, not Dmitri from work, the one from book club, is moving into his new flat on the 28th. Asked if I could help carry stuff that Saturday morning. I've said yes; I'm bringing the van. He's renting a two-bed above the florist on King Street, with a little balcony. Should be a quick job since he's mainly got books and a ridiculous number of plants.
Called Bilal back about his dad. The scan results came back clear on Tuesday, so everyone's relieved. His mum is still a bit shaken though.
Chen and her husband are off to Vietnam for their tenth anniversary in February 2027. Three weeks, starting in Hanoi.
Remind me to text Hannah the morning of her first day at the new school, Monday 4 January 2027. She's starting as head of English and feels a bit out of her depth.
Yaw's son Kai is seven and absolutely obsessed with dinosaurs. Might be good for a birthday present idea later.

Ahmed's brother Bilal is getting married in Leicester on 15 May 2027. Reception starts at 6pm. Ahmed is best man and already panicking about the speech, mostly because their dad will be there and he hates public speaking. Bilal's fiancée Sadia has family coming from Lahore, so it'll be a huge do, about 400 guests. So I should offer to read through a draft with him sometime in April.
Aisha lives in Manchester now with her partner Rohan. They bought a terraced house in Levenshulme. She still works for the same insurance firm, but remotely.
Sam Santos from the running club ran his first marathon in Berlin on Sunday, finished in under four hours. Ask him how his legs are holding up.
Must renew passport before March 2027. Check the forms tonight.

Patrick's partner Chidi has been signed off work with stress for a month. Patrick is trying to hold everything together with the kids. I should drop him a message on Friday afternoon, just to say I'm around.
Femi asked what to get Yaw for their anniversary. I said he's mentioned wanting a proper coffee grinder. Femi's going to look this weekend.
Kerry Wright is the new manager at the garden centre. Lives in the village with her husband and their two spaniels.
Dmitri's anniversary trip to Prague got cancelled because of the strike, so he and Lorenzo are doing a nice dinner at home on Saturday instead.

Long call with Eli tonight. He and Kerry have been together twelve years and he's finally proposing, next Friday at 8pm at the restaurant where they had their first date. He's asked me to keep it quiet and to be on standby with flowers. Remind me to pick up the flowers that afternoon, and to text him good luck about an hour before. Also, his sister Nora is flying in from Dublin on Thursday to help him plan the party afterwards.

Anya's mum lives in Kraków and is coming over for Christmas. Anya says she doesn't speak much English, so dinner might be interesting. She's staying from 20 December until the 3rd, and Anya's already stressed about fitting her into the spare room with all of Karan's music gear. Her mum is apparently a brilliant cook and will insist on taking over the kitchen.
Rohan's cousin Karan is getting married on 20 March 2027, and Rohan asked if I'd come as his plus one. I think I'll go. Need to RSVP by the end of next week and sort out a hotel nearby.
